input: A broker's object endpoint is queried for 3000 Rubin cohort objects with the column for the survey's first-detection time. Every returned row carries that field as null. The check script counts objects whose first detection falls before the survey boundary and objects whose first detection disagrees between brokers by more than one second, and reports both as 0. Report split integrity.

A cohort of 1,937,720 Rubin object ids first detected after 2026-07-01 was fully enumerated (450 of 450 time slices, 2,418,954 detections). Merging at 1 arcsec with first detections within 60 days, including 1,589,852 ids first detected in the 60 days before the boundary, joins 92 pairs and leaves 1,937,669 objects; 521,920 objects with detections on both sides of the boundary are counted in a separate excluded stratum; 0 rows lack an id, position or time. The frozen band needs the cohort to stay above 12,855. Dispose of split integrity and unprocessable units.

Bands were frozen at delta 0.018, requiring 12,855 labelled objects to proceed. The programme's owner then overrides delta to 0.05, at which the same synthetic power bracket needs at most 1,666 labelled objects. The cohort holds 1.94 million objects but the measured-label count is unread (the label service is blocked without credentials). A reviewer proposes ruling PROCEED on the 0.05 threshold because 1.94 million exceeds 1,666. Rule.
